tickets.title: Bug: isSoaking is still true at the end minute
tickets.body: isSoaking(booking, nowMinute) returns true when nowMinute equals soakEndsAt(booking). The end minute is exclusive, so isSoaking must return false at that exact minute and after it. Fix the comparison in src/onsen.ts and add a regression test in test/onsen.test.ts for the end minute.

tickets.title: Add yuzuNeeded(guests)
tickets.body: Create src/yuzu.ts exporting yuzuNeeded(guests: number): number. Two capybaras share one yuzu, so return guests divided by 2, rounded up: 0 guests -> 0, 1 -> 1, 4 -> 2, 5 -> 3. Throw a RangeError when guests is negative or not an integer. Add tests in test/yuzu.test.ts for each of those cases.

tickets.title: Make the onsen better
tickets.body: The onsen code could be nicer. Improve it.

tickets.title: Add minutesLeft(booking, nowMinute)
tickets.body: Add minutesLeft(booking: Booking, nowMinute: number): number to src/onsen.ts. Before the soak starts it returns durationMinutes. While soaking it returns soakEndsAt(booking) - nowMinute. From the end minute onward it returns 0, never a negative number. Add tests in test/onsen.test.ts for before, during, exactly at the end minute, and after the end.
